recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast portrait where one half of the subject's face is completely obscured by deep black shadow, while the other half is rendered in a bright cyan duotone. The composition is centered and balanced by minimalist, sans-serif typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: 50/50 vertical split between deep shadow and highlighted detail
Monochromatic cyan background matching the subject's highlights
Tight cropping on the face, glasses, and headwear
Symmetrical placement of text elements in top corners
coreInvariants: Absolute black shadows with zero detail
Uniform cyan tint across all non-black areas
Sharp, clean edges on the shadow transition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale central portrait, head and shoulders, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye and glasses frame on the right side of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the high-contrast split in the center, then to the visible eye, and finally to the text in the upper corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid cyan background surrounding the head, creating a clean silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between black and cyan; low saturation variance.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching font family for both corners to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man with glasses and a baseball cap. Apply a harsh vertical split light so the left side is in total black shadow. Apply a cyan duotone filter to the entire image so the highlights and background are bright cyan.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed, black sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. Ensure the text is uppercase and has tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the shadow side absolute black?
Is the background a uniform cyan?
Is the text perfectly aligned to the top corners?
Is the subject's eye clearly visible through the glasses?

adjustableVariables: Duotone color (e.g., change cyan to red or yellow)
Subject features (e.g., different hat, no glasses)
mustRedesign: Artist name and specific album title
Any specific logos on the hat
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no detail is visible in the black shadow area.
Check that the cyan color is consistent across the background and skin highlights.
Verify the typography is bold and legible against the cyan.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast split-lit portrait with a duotone color map and minimalist corner-aligned typography.
